notes: DHB4 (K-12) wild type or degP deletion, carrying empty pAL-0 or a FevR plasmid (FevRCit from Citrobacter, FevREco105 from an environmental E. coli; both treated as heterologous_expression). Wild type at 42 C was grown 4 h at 42 C (adapted heat); degP mutant at 42 C was shifted from 30 C for 1 h (short heat). Only wild type + pAL-0 at 30 C is the control; degP + pAL-0 is the background of its own comparison but not the reference genotype. Inducer for pAL not described, so inducer_added left out. Shaking not stated (flask), so culture_mode/oxygen left out.

base_medium.q: Cells were grown overnight in 5ml LB media + 10µg cloramphenicol

medium_class.q: Cells were grown overnight in 5ml LB media

amino_acids_supplied.q: Cells were grown overnight in 5ml LB media

growth_phase.q: These cultures were grown for 4 hours until they reached exponential phase before applying treatment

transcription_arrested.q: compared to empty vector, in different conditions: background strain E. coli K-12 DHB4 wild type or ΔdegP

mixed_organism.q: compared to empty vector, in different conditions: background strain E. coli K-12 DHB4 wild type or ΔdegP

assay_class.q: Ribosomal RNA was removed from the total RNA with NEBNext® rRNA Depletion Kit

rrna_removal.q: Ribosomal RNA was removed from the total RNA with NEBNext® rRNA Depletion Kit

is_control.q: Differential expression of genes by one of the two homolog transcriptional factor, FevRCit or FevREco105, compared to empty vector
